name: Tazri
description: Tazri is a human general of Zendikar's allied forces, a former caravan captain who wears the halo of an angel she mercy-killed, and later Commander-General and leader at Sea Gate.

bio.text: After the Eldrazi overran Sea Gate she met Gideon at a refugee camp, and the dying Vorik named Gideon Commander-General against her wishes, though she pledged to fight beside him.

bio.text: When Kozilek's wave struck, her halo saved her, and she took command of the survivors and persuaded Drana to follow her.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion she defended Sea Gate until it fell, then led a party with Akiri, Linvala and Orah that broke the compleated Nahiri loose from the hedron network so the Skyclave crashed with her inside.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
timeline.quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon meets Tazri and the wounded Vorik, who says the survivors have nowhere to run.
timeline.quote: "Yes," Vorik said flatly. "We could have used you."

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon proposes moving the survivors up onto the floating hedrons, and Vorik agrees.
timeline.quote: "Fine," Vorik said. "Lead the way."

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Tazri and the kor lead the wounded survivors up ropes onto the hedrons.
timeline.quote: They made the ascent with no complaints, no missteps, and no further injuries.

citation.text: "Slaughter at the Refuge" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri accuses Gideon of wasting time and of waiting for Jace, and Gideon admits he is not from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: "You're right. I'm not from this world."

citation.text: "The Survivors of Sky Rock" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: A group of refugees insists that Sea Gate is Zendikar's only hope, and Tazri tells them it is gone.
timeline.quote: "Sea Gate is Zendikar's only hope."

citation.text: "The Survivors of Sky Rock" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon argues before the dying Vorik for retaking Sea Gate instead of evacuating to Zulaport.
timeline.quote: "I would have us go back to Sea Gate."

citation.text: "The Survivors of Sky Rock" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Vorik names Gideon Commander-General of the Zendikari and tells Tazri to support him.
timeline.quote: You will reclaim Sea Gate, Commander-General Jura.

citation.text: "The Survivors of Sky Rock" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri pledges to fight beside Gideon, and the crowd cries 'For Zendikar!'
timeline.quote: "For Zendikar, Commander, I will battle too."

citation.text: "The Survivors of Sky Rock" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: As a caravan captain Tazri finds a wounded angel and kills her as an act of mercy, taking her halo, and is cursed.
timeline.quote: She killed the angel as an act of mercy and took the angel's halo as a way to remember her.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "Earlier years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri falls on bad times and joins the Sea Gate militia, where Vorik sees her potential.
timeline.quote: She immediately caught the interest of militia captain Vorik

citation.text: "Tazri", section "Earlier years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate is overtaken by the Eldrazi; Tazri meets Gideon Jura at a refugee camp.
timeline.quote: She first met Gideon Jura in a refugee camp outside the city, after a battle with Ulamog's spawn.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorik dies of his injuries and, against Tazri's wishes, names Gideon as his replacement.
timeline.quote: contrary to Tazri's wishes, he named Gideon as his replacement.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri joins Gideon, Drana and Munda to retake Sea Gate; a failure kills many Zendikari but Sea Gate is reclaimed after training.
timeline.quote: Despite her worries, Sea Gate was reclaimed after intensive training

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri meets Nissa and Kiora and urges evacuation while Gideon, Drana and Kiora plan to fight the titan; Jace proposes trapping Ulamog with the hedron network.
timeline.quote: saying Ulamog could be trapped using an aligned hedron network.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
timeline.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri survives Zendikar's Last Stand in which the Gatewatch defeat the titans, and leads rebuilding.
timeline.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri sounds a horn to rally the survivors, and the army regroups at camp as the sun sets.
timeline.quote: As the sun touched the horizon, the army of Zendikar was coming back together.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri tells Gideon the battle was a disaster because he led from the front and gave his army no plan or strategy.
timeline.quote: They need to know how they fit into the army and the overall plan of attack.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes he has failed his commanders as well as his army and takes Tazri and Munda to work out a plan.
timeline.quote: "Walk with me, Tazri," he said.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Over several days Gideon meets with the commanders and builds a plan that gives every contingent a role.
timeline.quote: Over the next few days, a plan came together.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
timeline.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
timeline.quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora volunteers to lead the offensive and demonstrates the bident by sending a wave through the window.
timeline.quote: Only the most powerful artifact on all of Zendikar

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, after a moment alone, orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan.
timeline.quote: We do not evacuate. We stay and we fight. And we kill the titan.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises, Ulamog is freed, and Tazri rallies her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Tazri rallied her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: A shimmering wave from Kozilek crashes over the fleeing army, killing Romoe, Magain and Debins horribly.
timeline.quote: Time slowed. Insanity blossomed.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The wave hits Tazri and her angel's halo glows as her past and future flicker through her mind.
timeline.quote: Time, previously slowed, now stretched .

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: young caravan captain Tazri halts Mahir's caravan on Tazeem because something feels wrong.
timeline.quote: "Halt!" Tazri raised her hand

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tazri and Romoe find six dead vampires and a dying angel who begs to be killed.
timeline.quote: Please. Help me. End. Me.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tazri kills the angel despite warnings of a curse and takes her halo, losing something unnamed in herself.
timeline.quote: She reached down to take the dull gray halo from the angel's eyes.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: years later, fired by caravan merchants and unable to dream, Tazri asks Vorik for a militia job and he hires her.
timeline.quote: I could use a fighter like you.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Vorik, dying, names Gideon Jura his successor, and Tazri feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: when I am gone, you will lead these people.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Kozilek repeatedly resurrects and kills Gideon for amusement.
timeline.quote: Another twitch, another ripple , and Gideon Jura was reborn again

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: after Kozilek leaves, Tazri spends ten thousand years trying to recreate Zendikar, and then billions of years in sleep waiting for him.
timeline.quote: For the first ten thousand years after Kozilek's disappearance, Tazri had used her new powers to attempt the reconstruction.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri tells herself the story of the day Gideon died through the dead cosmos.
timeline.quote: This is the story of the day Gideon died.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The halo shields Tazri's mind, and she meets the angel she killed in a white void outside time.
timeline.quote: We are outside of time, Tazri.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri refuses to be healed, saying the sacrifice was hers, and the angel tells her she is forgiven and that Zendikar can win.
timeline.quote: You can win. You will win. There is no other option.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri returns to find her soldiers dead and Kozilek far away, and sees Noyan Dar's roilmages obliterated by reflected fire and earth.
timeline.quote: Tazri didn't have time to shout a warning as the fire and earth swept through the roilmages, obliterating them.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri assumes command, tells Noyan Dar to open a rift and orders Munda to prepare the troops to flee, leaving the dying behind.
timeline.quote: Munda, prepare the troops. We are getting out of here.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri persuades Drana to follow her as general and to feed energy to Noyan Dar.
timeline.quote: As you command, General Tazri,

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri decides the battle for Zendikar is just beginning.
timeline.quote: The battle for Zendikar was now truly beginning.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans head to Halimar Basin; the Sea Gate survivors regroup and are joined by Kiora.
timeline.quote: The survivors of the Sea Gate effort regrouped under General Tazri

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: General Tazri is saved by her halo and takes command of the regrouped forces.
timeline.quote: General Tazri was saved by the protection of her halo.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
timeline.quote: The demon took him, and two others.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
timeline.quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
timeline.quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace proposes using the army as bait to bring the titans together, and Tazri says bait does not get a choice.
timeline.quote: The titans are drawn to concentrations of life,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri, now Commander-General, runs with Gideon and tells him she is addressing departing volunteers.
timeline.quote: The burden of command. It was now hers—Commander-General Tazri.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon says he is hers to command until he must go elsewhere to face new threats.
timeline.quote: he had pledged to the Gatewatch to intervene where others couldn't.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Fed up with the expeditionary houses' infighting, Tazri drafts her own plan for Sea Gate, which Linvala backs, and the city is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Fed up with the houses' infighting, Tazri drafted a plan of her own.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri drafts her own rebuilding plan for Sea Gate, backed by the angel Linvala, and the city is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Within a year, the city was restored.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri commands Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians from the Invasion Tree's branches.
timeline.quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala reports that the lithomancer has returned, though not as an ally.
timeline.quote: "She has not returned as an ally."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Erem is speared, dragged into a seedpod and transformed, laughing mechanically, as Tazri fails to save him.
timeline.quote: two invaders drag him into the nearest seedpod and seal him within.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala carries Tazri away as Sea Gate falls to the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: From above, Tazri watches in horror as her home is, again, consumed by creatures not from this plane.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala brings Tazri to Akiri's party, and they agree they are the only ones left to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
timeline.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
timeline.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
timeline.quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
timeline.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is lost.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.
